clock: stages use wall and actual worker thread CPU; cProfile uses thread CPU

database_observer.timing_scope: nested inclusive times; do not sum or label as pure queue/lock/server time
database_observer.clock_scope: CPU endpoint read before wall endpoint; UTC formatting excluded from CPU; clock reads are not atomic
database_observer.rows_uow_scope: single-engine application assumption; Session and cursor hooks explicitly target installed engine
database_observer.result_scope: proxy preserves operations used by production Rows; not a general Result type substitute
database_observer.privacy: no SQL text, bindings, URL, credentials, body or exception messages
